title: mockupPlan
responsibility: Author static mockup source with Sonnet and extend requested widths and states with Haiku.

inputs.name: mockupPlan.context
inputs.description: Prepared visual Plan context with reviewed source revision, request, provider and renderer.

inputs.name: mockupPlan.proposal
inputs.description: Design request or proposal text supplied to the mockup author.

outputs.name: mockupPlan
outputs.description: Source, provenance, prompts, and screenshot drafts ready to commit together as one version.

errors.name: MockupFailure
errors.description: Authored output, source provenance, variants, or review limits failed validation.

errors.name: RunCancelled
errors.description: The owner cancelled the Plan while authoring or rendering was in progress.
